subject: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@ancora.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our conversation, Ancora is a great fit for the Azure Marketplace co-sell program and we think switching your renewal to marketplace billing will: reduce procurement overhead for your finance team, enable consolidated cloud invoicing, and unlock co-sell marketing/sales motions with Microsoft.

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with a timeline that aligns the billing migration with your Oct 1 renewal. High level proposal:
- Target go-live on Azure Marketplace: 2027-10-01 (coincides with renewal)
- Contract: move to marketplace invoicing (monthly consumption invoice from Microsoft) with a 12-month term
- Commercial: preserve existing unit price for first 90 days post-migration, then move to published marketplace price; we can discuss a one-time onboarding credit to smooth transition

Key asks for Ancora to expedite: finance confirmation for marketplace invoicing, legal approval of the marketplace terms (we've attached our standard marketplace appendix), and a short intake call between your procurement and Azure marketplace onboarding team.

Would you be available next week (Aug 24–26) for a 30-min planning call with Alan (CFO) and Priya (procurement)? Vanessa and I will run the runbook and Marissa will coordinate the co-sell listing details.

Thanks —
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@ancora.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Wright <alan.wright@ancora.io>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@ancora.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 15:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment

Rishi —

Appreciate the clear plan and the MAP. I ran this by Alan and Priya; they're open to the marketplace move but have two immediate questions:
1) Will Microsoft issue a single consolidated monthly invoice for Redwood spend, or will we still receive separate redwood line items per subscription? They prefer consolidated.
2) Legal: What changes in terms are we signing vs our current Redwood master subscription? Samuel (legal) is copied and can review the appendix.

We're available Aug 25, 11am PT for the planning call. Please confirm and send an invite. Also, please include a short one-page note on the cost delta and any credits so our finance team can review pre-call.

Thanks —
Emily

--
Emily Chen
Head of Revenue Operations | Ancora Analytics
emily.chen@ancora.io | +1 (617) 555-4442
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@ancora.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alan Wright <alan.wright@ancora.io>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@ancora.io>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@ancora.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment

Emily / team —

Confirmed for Aug 25, 11:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent. I've attached a one-page summary of expected cost delta and proposed onboarding credit. Quick answers to your questions:
• Invoicing: Once live on Azure Marketplace, Microsoft will be the billing party and can provide a consolidated monthly invoice; we'll help coordinate with your MS account team to ensure line-item formatting meets your AP needs.
• Terms: The marketplace appendix aligns commercial terms with our existing subscription; it mostly replaces the invoicing section and adds marketplace-specific language about billing flow and support coordination. Samuel — feel free to flag any redlines.

Agenda for the call (15–20 min agenda, then Q&A):
1) Overview of timeline and MAP owners
2) Invoicing mechanics (MS consolidated invoice)
3) Legal checklist & DocuSign walk-through
4) Next steps / week-by-week runbook

Attachments: Ancora_Marketplace_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx; Marketplace_Billing_Terms_v3.docx; Redwood_Azure_Listing_Draft.pdf

Best —
Rishi
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@ancora.io>, Alan Wright <alan.wright@ancora.io>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@ancora.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment

Thanks everyone for the time. Follow-up notes from today's planning call:
- Go-live target: 2027-10-01 (matches renewal). Owner: Ancora procurement (Priya) + Redwood marketplace ops (Marissa).
- Finance: Ancora to confirm consolidated invoice requirement via the Microsoft account team by 2027-09-03.
- Legal: Samuel to return any redlines on Marketplace_Billing_Terms_v3.docx by 2027-09-07. Redwood can accept a limited redline window to keep Oct 1 target.
- Commercial: Redwood will apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to one month of average consumption to ease the changeover if contract moved by Oct 1.
- Next: Marissa will begin the Azure listing intake and will share the draft listing URL (internal preview) by 2027-09-10. Marcus will verify co-sell registration prerequisites.

Action items (owners & dates attached in MAP). I attached the call notes and updated MAP row for legal/finance due dates.

Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Strategic Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0211

Attachments referenced: Ancora_Marketplace_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (updated), Redwood_Azure_Listing_Draft.pdf (preview)
From: Samuel Park <samuel.park@ancora.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@ancora.io>, Alan Wright <alan.wright@ancora.io>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@ancora.io>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment

Rishi / Vanessa —

I've reviewed Marketplace_Billing_Terms_v3.docx. High level comments:
1) Payment flow: please clarify how refunds or credits are processed when Microsoft is the billing intermediary. We need explicit language that Redwood will cooperate in issuing credits and that Microsoft will reflect them on the customer invoice within one billing cycle.
2) Data residency clause: we need assurance that billing metadata and purchase orders transmitted to MS will not change our data residency commitments.

Attached are two small redlines in the docx. If Redwood accepts those edits we can sign quickly. Otherwise we may need legal to loop in later.

Thanks —
Samuel
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@ancora.io>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@ancora.io>, Alan Wright <alan.wright@ancora.io>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@ancora.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Move Ancora to Azure Marketplace billing & co-sell alignment

Emily / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on redlines, Samuel. We reviewed and accepted the refund/credit language and added a short note on billing metadata handling to respect data residency requirements. I've uploaded the final marketplace appendix and prepared a short listing preview: https://portal.azure.com/marketplace/drafts/ancora-redwood (preview).

Next steps (final):
- Legal DocuSign: I created the envelope and shared with Samuel & Alan. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ENVELOPE-987654321
- Finance validation: Ancora to confirm consolidated invoice attributes with MS by 2027-09-03 (Priya).
- Listing review: Marissa to publish internal preview for co-sell registration by 2027-09-10. Marcus will validate co-sell prerequisites that week.

If we get signatures and finance confirmation this week, we remain on track for Oct 1 marketplace billing start.

Best —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0244

Attachments: Marketplace_Billing_Terms_v3.docx (final), Ancora_Marketplace_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (final)
